set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace

theorem finite_family_union_isOpen_in_subspace (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] (T : Set X) (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Set X) (h : ∀ i x, x ∈ T → x ∈ A i → ∃ U : Set X, x ∈ U ∧ IsOpen U ∧ U ∩ T ⊆ A i) : IsOpen ((fun x : T => (x : X)) ⁻¹' (⋃ i : Fin n, A i)) := by
  rw [preimage_iUnion]
  apply isOpen_iUnion
  intro i
  rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
  rintro ⟨x, hxT⟩ (hx : x ∈ A i)
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, hU, hUT⟩ := h i x hxT hx
  have hU_open : IsOpen ((Subtype.val : T → X) ⁻¹' U) := hU.preimage continuous_subtype_val
  have hU_mem : (Subtype.val : T → X) ⁻¹' U ∈ 𝓝 (⟨x, hxT⟩ : T) := hU_open.mem_nhds hxU
  refine Filter.mem_of_superset hU_mem ?_
  rintro ⟨y, hyT⟩ (hyU : y ∈ U)
  exact hUT ⟨hyU, hyT⟩

  change (y : X) ∈ ⋃ i : Fin n, A i
  apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
